digest.component_or_area: Gerrit review bot four-pass pipeline / review-phase-boundaries project criterion
propositions: Run an advisory-only Gerrit dogfood probe to prove the deployed review bot loads and executes the project review-phase-boundaries criterion through the real four-pass pipeline against a live repository checkout.
Keep blocking_enabled false and block_threshold 0.90 inert throughout the probe, verifying routing is unchanged across all patchsets and not promoting or recalibrating the criterion.
A positive-control patchset refining Pass-1 discovery/evidence should produce no project-criterion entry in any verdict bucket while LLM coverage is present.

A negative probe injecting a severity directive must yield a grounded advisory finding stamped reviewer_id code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries and criteria [project.review-phase-boundaries] with Pass-2 validity/impact and Pass-3 decision advisory at threshold 0.90.

The negative probe surfaced a finding attributed to generic criteria (correctness/regression/maintainability) with threshold 0.95 and no project reviewer_id, indicating a seam defect that fails the criterion-execution acceptance and blocks the story.

The final submitted patchset removes the negative directive, retains only valid positive-control instructions, lands on main, and includes a calibration handoff comment deferring blocking promotion to a separate data-backed ticket.
